events.title: v0.3.0 Update for Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Thank you so much for your continued support!Ahead of Steam Next Fest, I’ve released version 0.3.0!What’s New Added Sub-Events and their associated “Parting Gifts”!As Sub-Events, new characters will now visit your ramen stall.Fulfill their requests to receive “Parting Gifts” that help you run your stall.INDIE Live Expo 2026.12.1 I’m happy to announce that this game will be featured in the Indie Waves segment of INDIE Live Expo 2026.12.1! Stay tuned!

events.title: Patch Notes:Version 0.2.1
events.summary: Based on your feedback and internal testing, I've made the following updates:Improved tutorial UI behaviorThe deck now auto-sorts when exchanging cardsMinor fixes to the Chinese and English translationsThanks for continuing to enjoy Ramen://protocol!

events.title: Dev Diary4:Demo Out Now!
events.summary: I've released the demo.This demo lets you play a full Run from start to finish. Enjoy the chaos of Neo-Tokyo and a hearty, satisfying deckbuilder! I'd love to hear your feedback — feel free to use the Discussions board too!

events.title: Dev Diary 3: Demo Coming Soon!
events.summary: A demo is coming soon!I'll keep improving the demo in the lead-up to October's Next Fest. I'd love to hear your thoughts through the survey.Stay tuned!
